name: Swiss Blueprint
provenance: Original numeric/visual proposal inspired by cyanotype engineering drawings and Swiss technical typography; not official CAD or third-party vendor tokens

typography.display: tight geometric grotesque headline paired with uppercase monospace drawing numbers
typography.body: 14–15px high-contrast technical copy with tabular numerals
typography.micro: 11–12px coordinate axes, scale ratios, tolerances, and numbered callout keys

layout.primary: drawing title block + schematic plate + synchronized specification ledger
other: ruled hairline frame with numbered coordinate ticks and explicit scale metadata
split schematic viewport and tabular component schedule with direct callout linking

interactionGrammar: select schematic callout pin via click or keyboard to highlight linked ledger row
toggle measurement units (mm / in) and optional coordinate grid overlay
filter engineering schedule by subsystem with explicit active count
negativeConstraints: decorative low-contrast grid lines obscuring tabular numerals
fake CAD measurements presented as certified engineering tolerances
click-only diagram pins without a keyboard-accessible tabular equivalent
glowing cyberpunk neon replacing crisp architectural chalk-on-cobalt contrast
